filters.minimumMinutesTooltipLabel: Does this exclude players by default?
filters.minimumMinutesTooltip: Optional filter. All players are eligible by default regardless of minutes played — every player with a valid rate is listed, ranked and compared, and shapes the population everyone else is measured against. Per-90 figures are volatile over short spells, so each row carries a sample label saying how much playing-time evidence is behind its figures. Set a floor here only if you want one.
filters.sampleBandTooltip: How much football the figures rest on, not whether a player counts. Nothing is excluded unless you ask: the default is every band, and this does not replace the minimum minutes filter.

results.emptyDescription: Try widening the age range, lowering the minimum minutes, or clearing the role filter.

rawFitNote.title: The two numbers in the Raw fit column
rawFitNote.first: Raw role fit is the weighted composite behind a player's best role, on a 0–100 scale. It is a score on its own terms: a raw 80 is a raw 80 whatever the population, which makes it comparable between players within one role, but not across different roles, because differently weighted roles do not share a scale.
rawFitNote.second: The smaller figure is the role fit percentile: where that composite stands among the players measured for the same role. It is the comparable one, and the one the best role was chosen by.
rawFitNote.third: Neither is a scouting grade, a probability, or a measure of quality.
